request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

messages.content:
Rule BR-CBTRN02C-003: Reject over-limit transaction based on current-cycle credit minus debit plus transaction amount

### given[0]: The account record was found for the cross-referenced account ID.
fields=['ACCOUNT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   391            END-READ
   392            EXIT.
   393        1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT.
   394            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
>> 395            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
>> 396               INVALID KEY
>> 397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
>> 399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 400               NOT INVALID KEY
   401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
   402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
   403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT

### given[1]: The credit limit, current-cycle credit and current-cycle debit are each signed amounts with 10 integer digits and 2 decimals.
fields=['ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT'] literals=[]
CVACT01Y.cpy:
     4        01  ACCOUNT-RECORD.
     5            05  ACCT-ID                           PIC 9(11).
     6            05  ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS                PIC X(01).
     7            05  ACCT-CURR-BAL                     PIC S9(10)V99.
>>   8            05  ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT                 PIC S9(10)V99.
>>   9            05  ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT            PIC S9(10)V99.
>>  10            05  ACCT-OPEN-DATE                    PIC X(10).
>>  11            05  ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE               PIC X(10).
>>  12            05  ACCT-REISSUE-DATE                 PIC X(10).
>>  13            05  ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT              PIC S9(10)V99.
>>  14            05  ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT               PIC S9(10)V99.
    15            05  ACCT-ADDR-ZIP                     PIC X(10).
    16            05  ACCT-GROUP-ID                     PIC X(10).
    17            05  FILLER                            PIC X(178).
    18       *

### given[2]: The working balance holds only 9 integer digits and 2 decimals. Integer digits above the 9th are dropped when the result is stored (no ON SIZE ERROR is coded).
fields=['WS-TEMP-BAL'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   183 
   184         01 WS-COUNTERS.
   185            05 WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT          PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
   186            05 WS-REJECT-COUNT               PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
>> 187            05 WS-TEMP-BAL                   PIC S9(09)V99.
   188 
   189         01 WS-FLAGS.
   190            05 WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC         PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
   191 

### when[0]: The working balance is calculated as current-cycle credit minus current-cycle debit plus the transaction amount.
fields=['WS-TEMP-BAL', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT', 'DALYTRAN-AMT'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   400               NOT INVALID KEY
   401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
   402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
>> 403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
>> 404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
>> 405                                     + DALYTRAN-AMT
   406 
   407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
   408                   CONTINUE
   409                 ELSE

### when[1]: The account credit limit is less than the working balance. If the limit is equal to or greater than the balance, this check passes.
fields=['ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT', 'WS-TEMP-BAL'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
   405                                     + DALYTRAN-AMT
   406 
>> 407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
>> 408                   CONTINUE
>> 409                 ELSE
   410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
   412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   413                 END-IF

### then[0]: The fail reason is set to 102.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON'] literals=['102']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   406 
   407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
   408                   CONTINUE
   409                 ELSE
>> 410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
   412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   413                 END-IF
   414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)

### then[1]: The reason description is set to 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC'] literals=['OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
   408                   CONTINUE
   409                 ELSE
   410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
>> 412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   413                 END-IF
   414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
   415                   CONTINUE
   416                 ELSE

### then[2]: Because the fail reason is no longer 0, the transaction is not posted. The reject count goes up by 1 and a reject record is written.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-REJECT-COUNT'] literals=['0', '1']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   207       *              DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD
   208                      MOVE 0 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   209                      MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   210                      PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN
>> 211                      IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
>> 212                        PERFORM 2000-POST-TRANSACTION
>> 213                      ELSE
>> 214                        ADD 1 TO WS-REJECT-COUNT
>> 215                        PERFORM 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC
>> 216                      END-IF
   217                    END-IF
   218                END-IF
   219            END-PERFORM.
   220

clause.description: clause id as given, e.g. when[0]

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 395-400 show the READ of ACCOUNT-FILE into ACCOUNT-RECORD, with the NOT INVALID KEY branch covering the found case."},{"clause":"given[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 8, 13 and 14 define ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT as PIC S9(10)V99."},{"clause":"given[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 187 defines WS-TEMP-BAL as PIC S9(09)V99, and dropping high-order digits on store is standard COBOL behavior; the absence of ON SIZE ERROR is not visible in the cited line itself."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 403-405 compute WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT + DALYTRAN-AMT."},{"clause":"when[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 407-409 continue when ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL and take the ELSE branch otherwise, i.e. when the limit is less than the balance."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 410 moves 102 to WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON in the ELSE branch."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 411-412 move 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION' to WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC."},{"clause":"then[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 211-216 post only when the fail reason is 0; otherwise they add 1 to WS-REJECT-COUNT and perform 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC."}]}
